description: Generic OData query against any dataset in the OpenFEMA dataset catalog — the escape hatch for datasets the convenience tools do not cover (e.g., NfipPolicies, IndividualAssistanceHousingRegistrantsLargeDisasters, FemaWebDeclarationAreas, PublicAssistanceApplicants). Accepts raw OData filter, select, orderby, and pagination parameters. For NfipPolicies, use propertyState (not state) for the state and reportedZipCode for the ZIP code — it has no countyCode; always include a ZIP filter to avoid timeout. The dataset name must match the exact OpenFEMA entity name (case-sensitive, e.g., NfipClaims). Names missing from the catalog return an unknown_dataset error; a listed dataset OpenFEMA does not serve through the API, or a retired version, returns dataset_not_served. A page holds at most 100,000 characters of records; when records remain past it, next_offset is the offset to continue from.

dataset.description: OpenFEMA dataset entity name (case-sensitive, e.g., NfipPolicies, FemaWebDeclarationAreas, PublicAssistanceApplicants).

filter.description: OData $filter expression (e.g., "state eq 'TX' and declarationDate ge '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'"). String values in single quotes. For a list of values use field in ('a','b'): OpenFEMA rejects filters nested more than 100 levels deep (about 90 chained and/or comparisons) and request URLs past about 8,900 characters.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (1–10000, default 100). A page also stops at 100,000 characters of records; when either bound leaves matching records out, next_offset names the offset to continue from.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Pass the previous page’s next_offset to continue.

name: fema_query_dataset

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_dataset`: The dataset name is not in the OpenFEMA dataset catalog. `dataset_not_served`: The OpenFEMA dataset catalog lists the dataset, but OpenFEMA answers its API endpoint with a 404 page, or the version is past its deprecation date and returns no records. `catalog_unavailable`: The OpenFEMA dataset catalog could not be read, so the dataset API version is unknown. `invalid_filter`: OpenFEMA rejected the filter expression — an unknown field, a value of the wrong type or range, or unparseable syntax. `invalid_select`: OpenFEMA rejected the select list — an unknown field or unparseable syntax. `invalid_orderby`: OpenFEMA rejected the orderby expression — an unknown field or unparseable syntax. `invalid_odata_syntax`: OpenFEMA could not parse the request and did not say whether filter, select, or orderby was at fault. `request_too_long`: The request URL, mostly the filter after percent-encoding, is longer than the roughly 8,900 characters OpenFEMA accepts. `filter_too_complex`: The filter nests more than 100 levels deep, the most OpenFEMA allows; every and/or adds a level. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page: offset plus returned_count. Present only while matching records remain past this page; pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Paging guidance — the offset to continue from and whether limit or the response budget ended the page, filter advice when nothing matches, or the total and last valid offset when offset is at or past the end — plus OpenFEMA’s notice when the dataset version is deprecated.

returned_count.description: Number of records in this response.

rows.description: Records from offset onward, bounded by limit and by 100,000 characters of records. Field names depend on the queried dataset.

items.description: A single record from the queried dataset. Field names and types vary by dataset.

totalCount.description: Total matching records before pagination — exceeds returned_count when results were capped at the limit.

title: Query Any OpenFEMA Dataset
